description: This file defines an abstract generic mapper class in Java, providing methods for converting between entity and DTO objects, including collections such as Lists and Sets.

classes.name: BaseMapper
classes.description: An abstract generic class providing conversion methods between entities and Data Transfer Objects (DTOs).

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Abstract method for converting a DTO to an entity, with optional additional arguments.

methods.name: convertToDto
methods.description: Abstract method for converting an entity to a DTO, with optional additional arguments.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Converts a collection of DTOs to entities.

methods.name: convertToDto
methods.description: Converts a collection of entities to DTOs.

methods.name: convertToEntityList
methods.description: Converts a collection of DTOs to a List of entities.

methods.name: convertToDtoList
methods.description: Converts a collection of entities to a List of DTOs.

methods.name: convertToEntitySet
methods.description: Converts a collection of DTOs to a Set of entities.

methods.name: convertToDtoSet
methods.description: Converts a collection of entities to a Set of DTOs.
